one_liner: Mermaid CLI (mmdc) is a local open-source renderer with no hosted API or credentials. The separate Mermaid.ai hosted REST API (free-account Bearer key, credit-metered, beta) and its MCP server are an alternative backend.
auth_notes: The CLI is a local tool run via mmdc and needs no credentials; the fetched GitHub excerpt does not state this explicitly. The separate hosted Mermaid.ai API uses a Bearer API key. The MCP server supports OAuth 2.1 or a pasted token.
access_notes: The CLI is open source and free to install. The separate hosted API works with free Mermaid accounts (Basic plan: 500 personal API credits a month), is credit-metered, and is in open beta.
blocker_notes: The named app, Mermaid CLI, is a local tool with no hosted HTTP API. A toolkit must run the CLI (which needs a headless browser) in a sandbox, or target the separate Mermaid.ai hosted API, which is beta, credit-metered and has no uptime guarantee. Whether the hosted API counts as this app is a judgment call. The MCP server comes from Mermaid.ai, not the mermaid-js CLI repo.

evidence.quote: Mermaid API is a hosted service that runs Mermaid for you: your program sends diagram code over HTTP and gets back a validation result, an image, or new diagram code.
Rendering Mermaid needs a headless browser. We run it, so you send one HTTP request.
Any Mermaid account works, including a free one, and every account gets a monthly allowance of API credits.
Mermaid API is in open beta. You can build on it; breaking changes are announced in advance in the changelog, and there is no uptime guarantee yet.
Authenticate automatically via **OAuth 2.1 with Dynamic Client Registration**
